description: Hybrid semantic-text retrieval over the drift_patterns memory. Reads through the `drift_patterns_read` alias (NOT the concrete index) so the offline pattern_curator can blue-green rebuild and swap the underlying index atomically without disrupting live retrieval (contracts.md §2.2.5). Given a natural-language query_text, returns up to top_k previously-distilled drift patterns ranked by ELSER similarity on the pattern_description field. The returned _score is NOT a reliable relevance threshold — the caller (Drift Analyzer or Memory Synthesizer) must read each pattern_description and judge relevance for itself. See contracts.md §3.2.1 (Drift Analyzer retrieval rules) and §3.5.1 (Memory Synthesizer retrieval rules). NOTE: the alias must exist (elastic/scripts/manage_pattern_alias.py init --apply) before this tool resolves; re-upsert via upsert_tool.sh after editing.

configuration.query: FROM drift_patterns_read METADATA _score | WHERE MATCH(pattern_description, ?query_text) | KEEP pattern_id, pattern_description, pattern_type, domain_tags, source_event_ids, support_count, record_source, _score | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT ?top_k

query_text.description: Natural-language text to retrieve patterns against. Drift Analyzer passes the joined preprint claim texts (per §3.2.1). Memory Synthesizer passes the new drift_event's drift_summary (per §3.5.1).

top_k.description: Maximum number of patterns to return. Drift Analyzer uses 3 (per §3.2.1). Memory Synthesizer uses 5 (per §3.5.1).
